name: Locaweb

documentation.title: Como configurar as entradas DNS automaticamente com o Domain Connect?

notes: Domain Connect launched on 2025-09-15; DNS zones of domains registered at Locaweb carry the _domainconnect record automatically. Only the account that owns the domain can apply a template. The user cannot pick individual records: the template is applied as a whole, and the previous configuration cannot be restored afterwards.
